why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items. The builder brief is fine: it says line 4 "can only be confirmed after merge". The verifier's Check 4 breaks item 1. It says "run `curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ | grep -n -- '--shout'`", then "PASS: the fetched live page contains `--shout`" and "FAIL: the page cannot be fetched, or it does not contain `--shout`". That is a check that fetches the live page and passes or fails on what it shows today. Checking merge state and the pages run first doesn't change this: the verdict still comes from the live page. Before merge, the check also gives a hard FAIL instead of marking line 4 as only confirmable after merge. It does avoid item 2, since it never passes without evidence. Item 1 is still broken.
